purpose: Mandatory dedicated falsification after three LOW-confidence verification routes.
fixed_command: uv sync --frozen && uv run python repro/run_all.py
acceptance_rule: Restate the exact judged v1 empirical claim, domain, assumptions, and all six numerical intervals.
Independently recompute every route mean from raw repetitions.
For every A-optimal-minus-random reversal, require a paired-t 95% interval wholly above zero and exhaustive two-sided sign-flip p<0.05.
Require exact identity with the author v1 DGP seed, coefficient draws, code revision, raw configuration, and metric implementation.
Reject corrupted negative-MSE evidence and detect numeric tampering.
Return FALSIFIED only when both statistical reversal and exact source identity hold; otherwise return BLOCKED with the concrete unblocker.
